topic: Equipment hosts and planners need for indoor events
summary: Georgetown's planner checklist names the equipment a host plans for: microphone, projector and screen, amplified sound, podium, speaker seating, sign-in table, chairs, tables and tablecloths, tents, stage equipment, piano, easels, trash boxes, water barrels, coat racks, flags, hand trucks, music stands and stanchions. Lectern, screen, stage, podium, pipe-and-drape, dance floor and tables were already in the library; this pass added coat rack, stanchions, poster and sign easels, piano, trash station, water and coffee stations, classroom table, charging station and photo backdrop frame. Per event type (conference, trade show, gala, wedding, classroom, fashion show, concert, market, hall, pop-up, birthday) the second engine also listed inventory ideas; these are planning suggestions, not specifications, and only the Georgetown list is checked against a page. The U.S. Chamber guide covers permits and insurance for markets and pop-ups, not sizes. Not opened by Claude (no web access).

sources.title: Planner Checklist (Georgetown Event Management Services)
sources.note: Reported verbatim: miscellaneous supplies (easels, trash boxes, water barrels, coat racks, flags, hand trucks, music stands, stanchions); on stage: podium, projector and screen, microphone, amplified sound; piano and piano tuning.

sources.title: Selling at Pop-Ups, Markets, and Fairs (U.S. Chamber of Commerce)
